title: Front End Developer
description:
**Associate – Software Engineering (Interface)**

**Job Summary:**

Job Title: Associate – Software Engineering (Interface)  
Location: Kakkanad, Kochi, India  
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent  
Experience: 1-3 years preferred  
Department: Engineering  
Reporting To: Senior Vice President – Engineering  
Preference: Immediate joiners preferred

**About Eloit**

Eloit Innovations is a London-headquartered global SaaS and software product company with strong engineering operations in Kochi, India. Eloit is on a mission of unlocking potential through graceful innovation.

Our platforms include Edisapp School ERP and LMS, Credisapp, Kristapp, BibleOn, and other growing technology products serving schools, institutions, and faith communities across the globe.

**The Role**

We are looking for an Associate – Software Engineering (Interface) to join our engineering team and contribute to building modern, responsive and engaging web applications. The role involves translating UI/UX designs into high-quality interfaces, integrating backend APIs, developing reusable UI components, and ensuring excellent performance, usability and cross-browser compatibility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain user-facing web applications using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and modern front-end frameworks.
* Build responsive, mobile-friendly and cross-browser-compatible web pages and applications.
* Convert UI/UX designs, wireframes and prototypes into functional and visually consistent interfaces.
* Develop reusable UI components and maintain consistent design patterns across applications.
* Integrate front-end applications with REST APIs and backend services.
* Handle data transfer, API requests, responses, validation and error handling effectively.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, QA engineers, Business Analysts and other stakeholders to deliver new features.
* Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs and suggest appropriate technical solutions where required.
* Optimise web applications for speed, scalability, performance and usability.
* Identify and resolve UI, functional, compatibility and performance-related issues.
* Conduct code reviews and follow established coding standards and development best practices.
* Maintain clean, reusable, scalable and well-documented code.
* Ensure websites and applications work effectively across different browsers, screen sizes and devices.
* Support QA teams during testing and resolve defects identified during development and testing cycles.
* Participate in requirement discussions, sprint planning, reviews and other Agile development activities.
* Stay updated with emerging front-end technologies, frameworks, tools and industry best practices.

**Requirements**

* 1–3 years of professional experience as a Front-End Developer.
* Strong proficiency in one or more modern front-end frameworks: React.js, Next.js, Angular or Vue.js.
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and jQuery.
* Good understanding of responsive and mobile-first web design principles.
* Strong understanding of UI/UX design principles and the ability to convert designs into functional interfaces.
* Experience in creating and customizing website templates and themes.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs and backend API integration, including data transfer and handling API responses.
* Understanding of JSON and asynchronous data handling.
* Familiarity with browser compatibility, accessibility and web standards.
* Good understanding of front-end performance optimisation.
* Experience working with Git or other version-control systems.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a development team.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Health Insurance
* Provident Fund
* Day Shift
* Opportunity to work on Front-End engineering for globally used SaaS products
* Values-driven and mission-oriented work culture

**Why Eloit?**

At Eloit, you will contribute to the quality of meaningful products used by schools, students, families, institutions, dioceses, parishes, and faith communities worldwide.

You will work on platforms such as **Edisapp**, an AI-powered School ERP and LMS with 150+ modules, secure data management, customisable workflows, and dedicated client support. You will also contribute to products such as **Kristapp, BibleOn, and Credisapp**, each built with a clear purpose and global vision.

This role offers an opportunity to strengthen your expertise in front-end engineering across multiple SaaS products, gain exposure to modern design tools and frontend workflows, and contribute directly to Eloit's mission of unlocking potential through graceful innovation.

We are a decade-old, London-headquartered Global SaaS / Software Product company with a passionate team in Kochi, India, building world-class platforms trusted by 700+ institutions across 4 continents. We move fast, build things that matter, and invest in the people who make it happen.

**How to Apply?**

Interested candidates may send their resume and cover letter explaining their suitability for this role to:

Email: jobs@eloit.com

Subject Line: Associate – Software Engineering (Interface)

Website: www.eloit.com

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Application Question(s):

* What is your Last Drawn Salary in CTC?
* What is your Notice Period?
* What is your Expected Salary?

Experience:

* Front-end development: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Junior Front End Developer
description:
**Position Overview:**

**Job Title:** Internal Hiring \- Junior Frontend Developer

**Location:** Remote (Occasional visits to Kochi office required based on work requirements)

**Department:** Development

We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented **Junior Front End Developer** with **around 2 years of experience** in building responsive web pages in front\-end development to build and maintain responsive and user\-friendly web pages.The primary focus of this role is HTML and CSS\-based development, converting UI designs into clean, functional interfaces. Candidates with additional frontend development skills (JavaScript frameworks, API integration) will have a strong advantage.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* HTML Development: Build and maintain responsive web pages using HTML5 and CSS3
* UI Implementation: Convert UI/UX designs into pixel\-perfect web layouts
* Responsive Design: Ensure compatibility across devices and browsers
* Basic JavaScript: Handle simple interactions and UI behavior
* Performance Optimization: Optimize pages for speed and SEO
* Bug Fixing: Resolve layout, styling, and responsiveness issues
* Code Standards: Follow clean coding practices and accessibility guidelines
* Collaboration: Work with designers and developers to deliver projects

**Added Advantage:**

* Experience with React, Vue, or similar frameworks
* API integration and dynamic content handling
* WordPress / CMS experience

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or any related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Minimum 2 years of experience in HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript
* Strong understanding of responsive design
* Familiarity with Bootstrap or Tailwind
* Basic knowledge of Git
* Attention to detail in UI implementation

**Application Process:**

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume outlining their qualifications and experience to **hr.kochi@mightywarner.com**. Please include “**Internal Hiring \- Junior Front End Developer**” in the subject line.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* What is your earliest date of joining?

Experience:

* Front\-end development: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kochi, Kerala
